I'm sorry this is so last minute. But it just occurred to me that I wanted to invite you all to celebrate the art opening of our very own A5 visa holder, Ayan Rivera. (if this is not okay content for this page, feel free to delete).
Why not rejoice in the wins for our community outside of just visas? A very well known gallery in Tel Aviv took a chance on an A5 visa holder. Woo hoo!!! 
Opening is today at Inga Gallery. in Tel Aviv. 
 From 11-14:00. 
We would love for you to join.
